title: Stationarity of a cone over a unit curve gives a weak conservation law
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, orthonormal u, e ∈ ℝ^P, reals r₀, s with 0 < s < r₀, every open N ⊆ ℝ^P with ⟨x, u⟩ > 0 for x ∈ N, every γ : ℝ → ℝ^P that is C¹ on (−s, s) with ‖γ(α)‖ = 1, ⟨γ(α), u⟩ > 0 and arctan(⟨γ(α),e⟩/⟨γ(α),u⟩) = α for α ∈ (−s, s), and every map T from ℝ^P to linear subspaces of ℝ^P with tγ(α) ∈ N and T(tγ(α)) = span{γ(α), γ′(α)} for t ∈ (r₀ − s, r₀ + s), α ∈ (−s, s): if ∫_S tr(P_{T(x)} ∘ DX(x)) dH²(x) = 0 for every C¹ compactly supported X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with tsupport X ⊆ N, where S := {tγ(α) : t ∈ (r₀ − s, r₀ + s), α ∈ (−s, s)} and H² := μHE[2], then ∫_ℝ φ′(α)κ(α) dα = 0 for every C¹ function φ : ℝ → ℝ with compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ (−s, s), where κ(α) := (⟨γ(α),u⟩² + ⟨γ(α),e⟩²)/‖γ′(α)‖.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e : Euclid P) (r₀ s : ℝ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P) (T : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ u e = 0 → 0 < s → s < r₀ → IsOpen N → (∀ x ∈ N, 0 < inner ℝ x u) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < inner ℝ (γ α) u ∧ Real.arctan (inner ℝ (γ α) e / inner ℝ (γ α) u) = α) → (∀ t ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s), ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, t • γ α ∈ N ∧ T (t • γ α) = Submodule.span ℝ {γ α, deriv γ α}) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ N → ∫ x in (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) '' (Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s), LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((T x).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[2] = 0) → ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo (-s) s → ∫ α, deriv φ α * ((inner ℝ (γ α) u ^ 2 + inner ℝ (γ α) e ^ 2) / ‖deriv γ α‖) = 0
